hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.briolink/role"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "Briolink session bound in this folder (.briolink/role): role $(head -c 40 "$f"). /briolink exit unbinds."; fi; exit 0

f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.briolink/role"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then r=$(head -c 40 "$f"); echo "Briolink session bound (.briolink/role): role $r. Handle this prompt as $r and start the reply with 'Role: $r'."; fi; exit 0
